title: Embattled National Trust for Historic Preservation Has A New President
summary: The currently highly put-upon National Trust for Historic Preservation nonprofit unanimously elected a new president, the organization announced on Monday. Brent Leggs, formerly the executive director of the African American Cultural Heritage Action Fund, will become the National Trust’s eleventh president since its founding in 1949. summary: Police conducting what The Telegraph described as a “routine narcotics raid” at a suburban Paris home discovered a painting by Pablo Picasso that had been stolen from its Singapore-based owner, Artnet News reports. title: Restoration of Parthenon’s Western Facade Is Unveiled
summary: The western pediment of the Parthenon, one of the main attractions of the Acropolis of Athens, Greece, has been partially restored to its full splendor and was unveiled to the public last Thursday. title: Misfits Paradise Lost: Paul and Mara McCarthy on the life and times of LA’s The Box
summary: The influential pair sit down to discuss the history of their gallery, the circumstances that led to its closure, and why the art world is failing their model.

title: Teresita Fernández Installation Will Grace The Reopening Of The Menil’s Fresco Building In Houston
summary: New York–based artist Teresita Fernández has been revealed as the first artist in a new commissions program for the reopening of the Menil Collection’s Fresco Building in late 2027. The historic structure, which has been closed since 2018, will be repurposed for semi-permanent, site-specific commissions. summary: A New York Supreme Court judge on June 16 gave billionaire dealer David Nahmad thirty days to return Amedeo Modigliani’s 1918 painting Seated Man with a Cane to the family of Jewish antiques dealer Oscar Stettiner, who left it in his Paris shop as he fled the Nazis during World War II. summary: In the lead up to the formal opening of the Obama Presidential Center in Chicago, former US president Barack Obama and former first lady Michelle Obama revealed their first dual portrait on June 15. summary: The Baloise Art Prize at Art Basel will not be awarded in 2026, the Art Newspaper reports. summary: The Trellis Art Fund has named the dozen artists making up its 2026 Milestone Grant cohort.
